findings: over

Past their materials’ limits at their worst moment: Maintaining ratchet 1545 MPa in brass against 300–450 (3.64 N·m, The key let go outright); Maintaining clicks 2350 MPa in steel against 1200–1800 (2.15 N·m on the click wheel, The key let go outright); Fusee wheel 400 MPa in brass against 300–450 (The key let go outright).
near
Near their limits (a margin under 1.5): Maintaining detent 1137 MPa, margin 1.1 (The key let go outright).
ok

The mainspring (0.37 mm) fully wound: 2599 MPa on its inner coils, 2442 along it, against its strip’s 2600 MPa: the inner coils, where the strip winds tightest round the arbor, carry more than its average.
over

The parts past their limits are all at the key let go outright: the fusee runs back onto its click (or pawl) and the blow passes to the maintaining work and the train. Easing the key back keeps them within their limits.
ok
The model’s own mechanism turns 8 arbors of the train at their tooth counts’ ratio, to 0.1 %.
